03-subclustering.Rmd

Sam Chen

2026-04-29

# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(SeuratObject)
library(scCustomize)
library(presto)

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v5")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "main-lineage-processing")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# Source function
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "run_doubletfinder.R"))
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "run_soupx.R"))

# set random seed
set.seed(1234)

Load data

obj <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "cart_annotated.rds"))

Visualize annotated Seurat object

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type", label = TRUE, label.size = 4) + 
  ggtitle("Annotated Lineages")
## Rasterizing points since number of points exceeds 100,000.
## To disable this behavior set `raster=FALSE`

## Separated by CAR-T conditions

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type", split.by = "condition", ncol = 3) + 
  ggtitle("Annotated Lineages by Condition")
## Rasterizing points since number of points exceeds 100,000.
## To disable this behavior set `raster=FALSE`

Myeloid subclustering

Subset myeloid cells

myeloid_cells <- c("Macrophages", "Microglia", "Monocytes")
myeloid_obj <- subset(obj, subset = cell_type %in% myeloid_cells)

Reprocess myeloid cells

myeloid_obj[['RNA']] <- split(myeloid_obj[['RNA']], myeloid_obj$sample)
## Splitting 'counts', 'data' layers. Not splitting 'scale.data'. If you would like to split other layers, set in `layers` argument.
myeloid_obj <- NormalizeData(myeloid_obj)
## Normalizing layer: counts.Tumor_only_D1
## Normalizing layer: counts.Tumor_only_D2
## Normalizing layer: counts.STOP_pos_T_D1
## Normalizing layer: counts.STOP_pos_T_D2
## Normalizing layer: counts.B7H3_pos_T_D1
## Normalizing layer: counts.B7H3_pos_T_D2
## Normalizing layer: counts.41BB-L_pos_T_D1
## Normalizing layer: counts.41BB-L_pos_T_D2
## Normalizing layer: counts.CD8-41BB_pos_T_D1
## Normalizing layer: counts.CD8-41BB_pos_T_D2
## Normalizing layer: counts.CD28-41BB_pos_T_D1
## Normalizing layer: counts.CD28-41BB_pos_T_D2
myeloid_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(myeloid_obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
## Finding variable features for layer counts.Tumor_only_D1
## Finding variable features for layer counts.Tumor_only_D2
## Finding variable features for layer counts.STOP_pos_T_D1
## Finding variable features for layer counts.STOP_pos_T_D2
## Finding variable features for layer counts.B7H3_pos_T_D1
## Finding variable features for layer counts.B7H3_pos_T_D2
## Finding variable features for layer counts.41BB-L_pos_T_D1
## Finding variable features for layer counts.41BB-L_pos_T_D2
## Finding variable features for layer counts.CD8-41BB_pos_T_D1
## Finding variable features for layer counts.CD8-41BB_pos_T_D2
## Finding variable features for layer counts.CD28-41BB_pos_T_D1
## Finding variable features for layer counts.CD28-41BB_pos_T_D2
myeloid_obj <- ScaleData(myeloid_obj)
## Centering and scaling data matrix
## Warning: Different features in new layer data than already exists for
## scale.data
myeloid_obj <- RunPCA(myeloid_obj, npcs = 30)

ElbowPlot(myeloid_obj, ndims = 30) # use 20 dims

myeloid_obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = myeloid_obj, method = CCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.cca", verbose=FALSE
)
## Warning: Number of dimensions changing from 50 to 30
myeloid_obj [["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(myeloid_obj[["RNA"]])

myeloid_obj <- FindNeighbors(myeloid_obj, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:20)
## Computing nearest neighbor graph
## Computing SNN
myeloid_obj <- FindClusters(myeloid_obj, resolution = 0.5)

Visualize myeloid subclusters

p1 <- DimPlot(myeloid_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, label.size = 4) + 
  ggtitle("Subclusters")
## Rasterizing points since number of points exceeds 100,000.
## To disable this behavior set `raster=FALSE`
p2 <- DimPlot(myeloid_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type", label = TRUE, label.size = 4) + 
  ggtitle("Myeloid Cell Lineages")
## Rasterizing points since number of points exceeds 100,000.
## To disable this behavior set `raster=FALSE`
p1 + p2

Split by condition

DimPlot(myeloid_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", split.by = "condition", ncol = 3) + 
  ggtitle("Myeloid Subclusters by Condition")
## Rasterizing points since number of points exceeds 100,000.
## To disable this behavior set `raster=FALSE`

## Save myeloid object

saveRDS(myeloid_obj, file.path(results_dir, "cart_myeloid_subclusters.rds"))
